name: Outbound resilience
usage: Make one client per external dependency with outbound({ name, baseUrl, timeoutMs }) and call it with client.call(path, opts); a call may lower the timeout but never drop or raise it. Wrap every outbound call that is not HTTP (database, queue, SDK) in withDeadline(name, timeoutMs, (signal) => work) and pass the signal on. A timeout is an OutboundTimeout with code "timeout". Keep test/sm-04-outbound.test.mjs: its last test fails the build on any direct safeFetch call in src/ that does not set timeoutMs. In the app's own tests, stub each dependency with a server that never answers and assert the call fails within its timeout.
